turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: What should I do if a thunderstorm catches me on a ridge?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Get off the high ground as fast as you safely can. Ridges and summits are the worst places to be.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: What if I can't get down in time?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Avoid lone trees and metal fences, and spread out if you're in a group. Crouch low on your pack, feet together, rather than lying flat.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Lying flat puts more of your body in contact with the ground, where current can travel. Crouching keeps that smaller.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: It is, but rare if you plan well. Check the forecast, and if storms are likely in the afternoon, be off the tops by lunchtime.
